info.name: PBL6 Round 3 Search excludes completed trip

item.name: SRCH-02 Completed trip excluded from sale search

exec: pm.test('Search succeeds and excludes completed synthetic trip',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array');pm.expect(b.items.some(x=>x.id==='01a1825e-ce81-77ac-a288-7ec225093288')).to.eql(false)});
